entities.summary: Irakli Turmanidze is a Georgian weightlifter. He competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the +105 kg event. In March 2024, Ruslan Albegov and Turmanidze were disqualified from the 2012 competition. Turmanidze later won a bronze medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the +105kg weight division.
